title: INSECT TAXONOMY — every automation IS an insect. Insects chew the veil. Swarm intelligence.
summary: Standardize all etymology and analogy. Everything inside the primal system that is automated, works on its own, sent out like honeybees — those are INSECTS. Termites chew anacondas (file splitting). Bees fetch nectar (API data). Wasps hunt (agents). Spiders weave webs (network). Fireflies beacon (heartbeats). Crickets chirp (pings). Caterpillars transform into butterflies (build → deploy). Moths find errors. Millipedes pipeline (CI). Pill bugs clean (GC). Dragonflies scout (profilers).

automation_is_insects.ant: worker scripts, npm, cron — follows trails, carries loads
automation_is_insects.bee: API fetchers, scrapers — flies out, finds nectar, dances location
automation_is_insects.wasp: AI agents, CI runners — aggressive, targeted, stings with precision
automation_is_insects.termite: linters, file splitters — eats dead wood, decomposes anacondas
automation_is_insects.caterpillar: compilers, bundlers — eats leaves, becomes butterfly
automation_is_insects.butterfly: deployed code — the caterpillar transformed, flies free
automation_is_insects.spider: web servers, websockets — builds web, connects nodes
automation_is_insects.firefly: health monitors, heartbeats — blinks, signals in the dark
automation_is_insects.cricket: ping systems, keep-alives — chirps constantly, keeps rhythm
automation_is_insects.pill_bug: cache clearers, GC — cleans decomposing matter
automation_is_insects.millipede: CI/CD pipelines — many legs = many steps
automation_is_insects.moth: error reporters, sentry — attracted to the bright spot (the error)
automation_is_insects.dragonfly: profilers, load testers — fast, sees in all directions

bounty_system.what: Tasks posted as bounties for insects (agents/modifiers) to claim
bounty_system.critical: CUT globe-core.js 6729 lines — termite swarm needed
bounty_system.flow: bounty posted → insect claims → chews → Gaia heals → bounty closes

should_not_tense.added: SHOULD_NOT — the boundary tense. The thing you must NOT do.
should_not_tense.meaning: Negative freedom — it CONSTRAINS. The warning. The guardrail.
